_about: ARMORY (Paolo 11/2, rule 302, ask line 289: 'more clothing, more weapons, the whole thing'). The valley's own weapons and armour, each a Battle Brothers ROLE in a Bohemia skin (scavenged, improvised, pre-collapse). THIS IS THE FILE A MODDER EDITS: one entry a piece. tools/bohemia_armory.py writes every entry into the files the game already reads (weapons.json rows, armor.json body/head rows, armour_names.json, armour_looks.json, ours.json pistol_shot.by_row, slices/rig_melee/rig_melee.json), each written row marked 'armory', so the shop, the fight, the loot, the crew screen and the icons all meet it with no new loader. THE NUMBERS: a piece sits BETWEEN two Battle Brothers rows of its own family ('between': [A, B]): its damage, armour damage, armour ignore, durability, weight and value are the mean of A's and B's (damage and percents to the nearest 5, value to the nearest 10), and it fights with A's own skills, reach and rounds, so every number traces to two wiki pages and the piece is its own tier, never a copy. Easier than Battle Brothers comes from TUNING's sliders over every row, not from these. 'carried_by': the brigand kinds whose wiki gear list holds A; in a fight every second man of that kind who drew A carries this piece instead (same family, same hands), so it drops as loot by tier. The shops sell it by its value like every row (a camp the cheap 40 percent, a town the middle, a fortress the top). 'object' is the drawn icon (slices/bohemia_ui_materials.js) for a weapon; an armour piece is drawn on the man as its 'class' (engine/bohemia_wear.js) and named the house way, a word of its own then the object its weight makes it (rule 202(d)). Words draft:true, eighth-grade.
rule: 302 (Paolo 11/2), 272 (the armour he wears shows), 194 (two hands), 195 (no gun is a club), 185 (guns reach two or more, fire at the man beside him), 170(b) (melee is one tile)
_about_round_2: ARMORY 2 (Paolo 11/2, rule 320, ask lines 316 and 317; records/BOHEMIA_ARMORY_THE_WHIP_AND_THE_POOL_POLE_SPEAR_11_2_26.md). Five more keys a piece may carry: 'starter' (on every camp's smith shelf, the camp's junk, whatever the roll); 'prop' (the family prop it is held as, when A's is wrong for it: a whip is held as the chain, never the cleaver); 'lash' (a whip: its blow is LASH, Battle Brothers' Whip page, and its reach is ours.whip.reach, two tiles; Disarm reaches as far); 'tune' (what moves off the mean of A and B, each with its 'why': 'add' adds, 'set' replaces, 'lash_hit_bonus' is LASH's to-hit); 'whip' (what the fight does on a lash: bleed_stacks, read by the fight off the row; VOTE FIXES 11/2 took out stun_pct, cells_per_lash, cuts_hands, gloves_at_armour and crack_nerve, his 'just animate, fuck these weird debuffs', and made Disarm every whip's luck roll on a landed lash, ours.whip.disarm_pct). Battle Brothers' own two whips (the battle whip, the thorned whip) reach two tiles too: the reach is the family's, not the piece's.
_about_round_3: WEAPONS (Paolo 11/7, rule 424(b), ask line 490: 'we need more one-handed weapons, I feel like there's not enough one-handed weapons'; records/BOHEMIA_WEAPONS_EVERY_WEAPON_SHOWS_11_7_26.md). Six one-handers a man finds in a dead Bohemia, each a Battle Brothers role in its own family, each its own model in the hand (tools/bohemia_weapons_every_weapon_shows_11_7_26.py): the tire iron, the golf club, the Bowie knife, the pipe wrench, the tomahawk and the slot machine handle. tools/bohemia_armory.py now only ADDS on a rerun: what a later lane wrote (a price, an own model, an own look) is kept.
_about_round_4: ARMORY 3 (Paolo 11/27, VAMILY rules 489(b) and 490, ask rows 758, 762, 763: 'we haven't even added automatic guns or more intense guns, maybe even a rocket launcher... I'm not even seeing any drones'). Sixteen guns and kits of a 2050 American collapse, REAL ONLY, each between two Battle Brothers rows of its family as before, and ONE NEW KEY a piece may carry, 'fire': {'mode': semi (a magazine, no reload between shots, Battle Brothers' Quick Shot cost: two a turn), burst (one press fires 'burst' rounds at one man, each its own roll, each after the first harder: Aimed Shot's cost, one a turn), belt (a burst that traverses three tiles, the handgonne's reload), rocket (the blast: the tile hit and its eight, the handgonne's reload), tube (one rocket a fight, refilled after: Battle Brothers' Firelance), drone (LAUNCH: it flies one turn and lands the next on the lit cross, rule 490), spot (the scout drone: his side sees them all), 'mag' (the real magazine), 'rounds' (what he carries into a fight, rule 478), 'per_shot' (rounds of the stock a refill costs), 'consumable' (never refilled from rounds: Battle Brothers' throwable items), 'sight' (night: the dark does not blind his shot; heat: nor the smoke)}. tools/bohemia_armory.py writes the skills each mode fights with (each Battle Brothers skill's own AP and fatigue), ours.json gun_rounds by_id, per_shot_by_id and consumable, and ours.armory_fire's numbers. The research and every number's source: records/BOHEMIA_ARMORY_THREE_THE_GUNS_GROW_UP_AND_THE_DRONE_11_27_26.md

fire_numbers.source: VAMILY.md rules 489(b) and 490 (Paolo 11/27); records/BOHEMIA_ARMORY_THREE_THE_GUNS_GROW_UP_AND_THE_DRONE_11_27_26.md (the research: the M4's three-round burst; Ukraine's FPV drones and the shotguns that shoot them down; the image intensifier and the thermal sight); the library: bb_all/0769_Fire Mortar (0 fatigue).txt (the spotter's call: marked one turn, lands the next, the man still on it hit) and bb_all/0770_Fire Pot.txt (an area 'friend and foe alike')
fire_numbers.quote: the drone maybe doesn't explode and move the same turn, and it's possible to escape from it, but an explosion from a drone is gonna be damn near a one KO for most people for sure
fire_numbers.why: ARMORY 3 OUR DEFAULT (draft, TUNING's to move; rule 490 names TUNING's research for the drone's number). BURST: each round after the first of a press lands 10 points harder (one Battle Brothers step, the same step ours.range_bands_card calls weak); a press stops when the man falls (the rounds are kept). DRONE: it lands on the spotter's cross (the tile and the four beside it, BESTIARY's call: the pilot chases a man one house) at the start of its operator's next turn; every man on it, either side as the call and the Fire Pot, takes hp_min to hp_max, armour_pct of it on his body armour and direct_pct straight through, a quarter less for each piece of cover on his tile: MEASURED on the fight's own rules (a 60-health man, 400 landings each, no cover): bare, a padded vest (55) or the licence-plate vest (85), struck down every time; the riot carrier (150) 35 percent, the road-sign riot armour (180) 32, the gilded riot armour (280) 40 (its straight-through share does it): rule 490(b), close to one hit for most men, heavy armour may live; a piece of cover cuts it a quarter. It is shot down by a gun at the shooter's chance against defence 40 (a small fast thing), a shotgun +25 (the Ukrainian finding: the shotgun is the surest small arm against one); a melee weapon cannot reach it (rule 490(d)). AUTO sends one where at least auto_min_men of the other side stand and none of his. SPOT: for 'turns' of the spotter's turns his side sees every man of theirs and its shots at them take hit_bonus (the drone walks the fire on). SIGHT: a night sight takes the dark off his shot (Battle Brothers' Nighttime -30 percent at a man in the dark), a heat sight that and the smoke's -20 too.

fire_bands._about: ARMORY 3: the bands the new pieces name (ours.range_bands): a rocket and a drone fall off with no distance on the board (an RPG reaches 200 to 330 m, an FPV the whole valley); the rest ride their family's band

fire_shapes.bb_says: none: Battle Brothers has no machine gun
fire_shapes.ours: the man aimed at and the tile each side of him, square across the line of fire: the belt walks across three houses (Paolo 9/24, rule 46d: 'a machine gun is comparable to a greatsword or a battle axe')

fire_shapes.bb_says: A thrown pot will set 7 tiles
fire_shapes.ours: the tile hit and its eight: Battle Brothers' Fire Pot's seven on hexes, the tile and its ring, are our nine on squares (hex_to_square)

_about_origins: ORIGINS (rule 427(c), Paolo 11/7 via the coordinator: 'every origin starts like itself and gets personal: its own look, things only it can buy, its own way'). A piece with 'origin' is that origin's own: its crew walks in wearing it (records/target/bb/origins.json door kit), and only that origin's home town sells it (engine/bohemia_origin_ways.js reserved(): no other shelf, no loot, no hire carries it). 'own' is its own model on the body (slices/wear, tools/bohemia_origins_their_own_gear.py, rendered through the master rig). Numbers the armory's way (the mean of 'between'), the Lone Wolf's two Battle Brothers' own golden named pieces ('tune'). A modder adds an origin's piece by adding a row with its 'origin'.
